intro: Make your gatherings feel big on warmth. Zara’s finish bar table saves floor space keeps glasses and bottles handy on its shelf, and turns kitchens or corners into lively, easy hosts too.

features.title: Space-smart footprint for small homes
features.text: You get a full 4-seater experience without crowding your kitchen or living corner, so casual breakfasts, work breaks, and evening drinks feel easy in the space you already have.

features.title: Shelf that keeps everything handy
features.text: The built-in shelf keeps bottles, bar tools, napkins, or snacks within reach, so you pour, prep, and host without leaving the conversation or hunting inside cabinets.

features.title: Solid rubberwood base you can trust
features.text: A solid rubberwood frame supports the MDF top, giving you a sturdy base that stays steady as you set out platters, clink glasses, and gather with friends.

features.title: Warm walnut look that elevates the room
features.text: MDF with ash veneer in a warm walnut-brown finish adds richness to your setup, pairing easily with light or dark bar stools and letting your space feel designed, not improvised.

features.title: Works in kitchen, dining, or living zones
features.text: Clean lines and neutral brown blend with your kitchen, dining, or living room, so you style it with existing stools or new ones and the look still feels cohesive and considered.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
